scope: Low-level DXF admission of the required definition and reactor references on POINTCLOUDEX records.

references.title: AutoCAD 2024 AcDbPointCloudEx API
references.finding: A PointCloudEx entity requires a linked AcDbPointCloudDefEx and a linked AcDbPointCloudDefReactorEx.

references.title: AutoCAD 2027 AcDbPointCloudEx API
references.finding: Confirms the definition and reactor links are part of the PointCloudEx contract.

behavior: writePointCloudEx refuses a zero source definition or reactor handle.
writePointCloudEx refuses when resolver/remap output for either required reference is zero, before staging the entity record.
The guard applies to direct low-level output and preserves destination bytes on refusal.

validation.source: Locally constructed in-memory POINTCLOUDEX records; no repository DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
cases: resolver returns zero for the required definition reference
resolver returns zero for the required reactor reference
every refusal preserves a preexisting destination sentinel
corrected references succeed through a fresh writer

limitations: This is generated low-level reference admission evidence; it does not prove either target exists or has the required object kind, ownership, or complete graph closure.
No physical producer profile, point-cloud asset availability/loading, rendering behavior, or native consumer qualification is established.
No DWG/DXF fixture was committed and no support claim is promoted.
